articles.title: XRP rockets 8% above $1.20 in first major breakout since June selloff
articles.snippet: Heavy volume pushed XRP through multiple resistance levels, with traders now focused on whether the rally can extend toward $1.30 after weeks of defensive positioning.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Bittensor (TAO) surges 31.9%, leading index higher
articles.snippet: Near Protocol (NEAR), up 22.2% from Friday, was also a top performer.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits a two-week high above $65,500 as the US-Iran deal sends oil sliding
articles.snippet: A peace agreement that reopens the Strait of Hormuz pulled the geopolitical premium out of oil and put back into risk assets.

articles.title: CFTC hires SEC crypto task force adviser with blockchain forensics chops
articles.snippet: The CFTC staff appointment came amid the US Congress seeking to overhaul federal financial regulators’ roles over digital assets with the CLARITY Act.

articles.title: Japan’s Bitbank cracks down on Polymarket-linked transfers
articles.snippet: Japanese crypto exchange Bitbank warns users of possible account suspensions for Polymarket-linked transactions, citing Japan’s gambling laws.
